text: Hello and welcome back to Real Easy
zh: 你好，欢迎回到《真实易英语》
zh_hant: 你好，歡迎回到《真實易英語》

text: English, the podcast where we have real conversations in easy English
zh: 这个播客用简易英语进行真实对话
zh_hant: 這個播客用簡易英語進行真實對話

text: to help you learn.
I'm Neil.
And I'm Becca.
You can find a video version with subtitles of this podcast on our website,
zh: 你可以在我们网站上找到这个播客的带字幕视频版本。
zh_hant: 你可以在我們網站上找到這個播客的帶字幕影片版本。

text: bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi Becca, how are you?
Yeah, I'm well, thank you, Neil.
How about yourself?
I'm very good.
I'm excited because we're talking about books
zh: 我很兴奋，因为我们要聊书
zh_hant: 我很興奮，因為我們要聊書

text: and reading today.
And I really love reading.
How about you?
Yeah, I like reading as well.
I do like reading.
How often do you read though?
Well, I read every day,
but different types of things.
So I sit down and read for the longest
zh: 我坐下来读最长时间的书
zh_hant: 我坐下來讀最長時間的書

text: period of time and the most serious kind of book when I'm traveling to and from work.
zh: 一段时间，以及我在通勤途中阅读的最严肃的书。
zh_hant: 一段時間，以及我在通勤途中閱讀的最嚴肅的書。

text: Oh, okay.
Yeah.
And when I'm at home,
I read stuff that's not so difficult,
because usually at home, I just fall asleep if I read.
zh: 因为通常在家，我一读就会睡着。
zh_hant: 因為通常在家，我一讀就會睡著。

text: Yeah.
So I see a lot of people reading on the tube,
zh: 我看到很多人在坐地铁时阅读
zh_hant: 我看到很多人在坐地鐵時閱讀

text: and I wish I could be that kind of person.
zh: 我希望我也能成为那种人。
zh_hant: 我希望我也能成為那種人。

text: But for me,
I only read when I'm in a relaxed environment.
zh: 我只在放松的环境下才读书。
zh_hant: 我只在放鬆的環境下才讀書。

text: So sometimes I'll go to the park in summer or take a book to the beach.
zh: 所以夏天我有时会去公园，或者带本书去海滩。
zh_hant: 所以夏天我有時會去公園，或者帶本書去海灘。

text: So I do like reading,
but I don't read as often as I feel like I should.
zh: 但我读得没有我理想中那么频繁。
zh_hant: 但我讀得沒有我理想中那麼頻繁。

text: So Becca, what kind of books do you like to read?
zh: 那么贝卡，你喜欢读什么样的书？
zh_hant: 那麼貝卡，你喜歡讀什麼樣的書？

text: I like short books.
I sometimes feel a bit stressed when I see a long,
thick book.
A lot of the books that I have on my shelf at home are poems.
zh: 我家书架上很多书都是诗集。
zh_hant: 我家書架上很多書都是詩集。

text: Poetry is a form of literature that's usually quite emotional
zh: 诗歌是一种文学形式，通常相当富有情感
zh_hant: 詩歌是一種文學形式，通常相當富有情感

text: and a lot shorter than a short story or a novel,
zh: 而且比短篇小说或小说短得多
zh_hant: 而且比短篇小說或小說短得多

text: for example.
Poems also sometimes have a lovely kind of sound quality to them if you read them
zh: 诗歌有时也有一种悦耳的音质，如果你大声
zh_hant: 詩歌有時也有一種悅耳的音質，如果你大聲

text: loud,
so some of the words might rhyme,
and they use a lot of metaphor.
So I really enjoy
short stories or books that have lots of poems. in them?
zh: 短篇小说或包含许多诗歌的书。
zh_hant: 短篇小說或包含許多詩歌的書。

text: How about yourself?
What stories or what books do you enjoy?
zh: 你喜欢什么样的故事或书？
zh_hant: 你喜歡什麼樣的故事或書？

text: I like fiction.
So fiction is when the story is not true.
zh: 小说就是故事不真实的。
zh_hant: 小說就是故事不真實的。

text: It's made up by the writer.
And I like novels.
And novels are fiction books that's just one quite long story.
zh: 而小说是虚构类书籍，就是一个比较长的故事。
zh_hant: 而小說是虛構類書籍，就是一個比較長的故事。

text: So, probably more than 100 or 150 pages.
Otherwise, it's a short story.
And short stories are shorter.
Yes.
Have you ever read a nonfiction book?
zh: 你读过非虚构类书籍吗？
zh_hant: 你讀過非虛構類書籍嗎？

text: So maybe something that's based on a real event
or a biography from someone's perspective that you really enjoyed?
zh: 或者某人视角的传记，你真的很喜欢的？
zh_hant: 或者某人視角的傳記，你真的很喜歡的？

text: Yeah, I like reading biographies as well.
So a biography is somebody's life story.
zh: 传记就是一个人的生平故事。
zh_hant: 傳記就是一個人的生平故事。

text: I like biographies of musicians and people like that.
zh: 我喜欢音乐家之类的人的传记。
zh_hant: 我喜歡音樂家之類的人的傳記。

text: Yeah, I know you play guitar,
so music seems to be quite a hobby that you enjoy.
zh: 所以音乐似乎是你很喜欢的爱好。
zh_hant: 所以音樂似乎是你很喜歡的愛好。

text: Yeah, definitely.
And I like reading about the lives of people who've worked in music.
zh: 我喜欢读那些从事音乐工作的人的生活。
zh_hant: 我喜歡讀那些從事音樂工作的人的生活。

text: Do you like nonfiction?
I prefer to watch nonfiction.
I prefer to watch documentaries.
I haven't read many nonfiction books.
zh: 我没读过很多非虚构类书籍。
zh_hant: 我沒讀過很多非虛構類書籍。

text: Do you have a favorite author?
Author, an author is a person who writes books.
zh: 作家，作家就是写书的人。
zh_hant: 作家，作家就是寫書的人。

text: Mm hmm.
Yeah.
So actually, a lot of my favorite authors,
zh: 实际上，我很多最喜欢的作家
zh_hant: 實際上，我很多最喜歡的作家

text: some of them have written novels.
I prefer poets,
so authors that have written poems.
And I prefer them, because they're quite moving,
zh: 我更喜欢他们，因为他们的作品很感人
zh_hant: 我更喜歡他們，因為他們的作品很感人

text: and usually quite short as well.
So I find that the authors that I enjoy the most write short things like poems or short stories.
zh: 所以我发现，我最喜欢的作者写的是短篇作品，比如诗歌或短篇小说。
zh_hant: 所以我發現，我最喜歡的作者寫的是短篇作品，比如詩歌或短篇小說。

text: OK, let's recap some of the vocabulary we've heard in this podcast,
zh: 好，让我们回顾一下本播客中提到的一些词汇
zh_hant: 好，讓我們回顧一下本播客中提到的一些詞彙

text: starting with fiction.
Fiction is a type of writing where the story is not true.
zh: 虚构类是一种写作类型，故事不真实。
zh_hant: 虛構類是一種寫作型別，故事不真實。

text: It's made up.
And the opposite is nonfiction.
Nonfiction is a true story.
zh: 非虚构类是真实的故事。
zh_hant: 非虛構類是真實的故事。

text: And our next word, novel.
A novel is a fiction, and it's usually a longer story.
zh: 长篇小说是虚构类，通常是较长的故事。
zh_hant: 長篇小說是虛構類，通常是較長的故事。

text: We also heard the word biography.
zh: 我们还听到了“传记”这个词。
zh_hant: 我們還聽到了“傳記”這個詞。

text: A biography is a type of book about a person's life.
zh: 传记是一种关于一个人生活的书。
zh_hant: 傳記是一種關於一個人生活的書。

text: And if that person wrote the story of their own life,
zh: 如果那个人自己写了关于自己生活的故事
zh_hant: 如果那個人自己寫了關於自己生活的故事

text: it's called an autobiography.
We also mentioned poems.
Now, poems are a shorter piece of writing,
zh: 诗歌是比较短的文字作品
zh_hant: 詩歌是比較短的文字作品

text: even shorter than a short story or a novel.
zh: 甚至比短篇小说或长篇小说还短。
zh_hant: 甚至比短篇小說或長篇小說還短。

text: And the sounds of the words and the ideas are very important
zh: 而且词语的声音和其中的思想非常重要
zh_hant: 而且詞語的聲音和其中的思想非常重要

text: in poetry.
That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 这就是本期《真实易英语》的全部内容。
zh_hant: 這就是本期《真實易英語》的全部內容。

text: But don't forget to go to our website, that's bbclearningenglish.com,
where you can find a free worksheet.
zh: 那里可以找到免费的学习单。
zh_hant: 那裡可以找到免費的學習單。

text: And we'll be back next week with another conversation in Easy English.
zh: 我们下周会带着另一段简易英语对话回来。
zh_hant: 我們下週會帶著另一段簡易英語對話回來。

text: Goodbye for now.
Goodbye.
